title: Easy Trash
description: Trash cans are added to remove unwanted waste!
body:
**_EASY TRASH:_**

Always have your inventory full when caving or exploring new places? This mod is perfect for you by adding the new trash can block
right click it to find 6 slots put your items in those slots and click the Empty Trash button to immediatly delete those items

**NOTE**: IF DELETED YOU CAN NEVER GET IT BACK

**RECIPE:**

Requires 5 iron ingots to be put in the crafting table the same way wooden planks is to make a boat
